title: A school credit card audit found a missing receipt and two apparent coding errors

beats.text: In fiscal 2023, a San Francisco school district card purchase had no receipt or invoice.

visual.sub: A transaction had no receipt or invoice

beats.text: The auditors did not identify the merchant or the purchase amount.

visual.kicker: A transaction had no receipt or invoice

beats.text: They also did not disclose how many transactions they tested.

visual.kicker: A transaction had no receipt or invoice

beats.text: Two purchases looked like travel and conference expenses.
Both had been booked under object 5890 for professional services.

visual.kicker: Two purchases appeared in the wrong expense category

beats.text: The report does not say whether these exceptions overlapped.

visual.kicker: Two purchases appeared in the wrong expense category

beats.text: Auditors recommended checking original receipts against the card statements each month.

visual.kicker: The district agreed to preapproval and monthly reconciliation

beats.text: The district agreed to train cardholders and require purchase preapproval.

visual.kicker: The district agreed to preapproval and monthly reconciliation

beats.text: In 2025 the following audit marked the corrective action implemented.
It did not say whether either entry was recoded.

visual.kicker: The next audit marked the action implemented

beats.text: The report did not identify any recovered money.

visual.kicker: The next audit marked the action implemented

beats.text: The original transaction records would show what ultimately changed.
